tubular-running-services-page.label: Preparation
tubular-running-services-page.title: Preparation
tubular-running-services-page.text: Every casing program starts before the pipe arrives at the rig. ProTorque coordinates thread inspection and cleaning, vacuum drifting, CRT readiness, and program-specific equipment confirmation in advance. By the time casing reaches the floor, the variables are gone.

tubular-running-services-page.label: Verification
tubular-running-services-page.title: Verification
tubular-running-services-page.text: Independent verification at every critical point. Hook load, top drive torque, iron roughneck calibration, and connection make-up data captured and documented for every joint. Operators see the numbers in real time and walk away with the records.

tubular-running-services-page.label: Execution
tubular-running-services-page.title: Execution
tubular-running-services-page.text: The same crews. The same standards. The same maintenance discipline on every tool that hits the floor. Whether the work is a new well in Canada, a workover in West Texas, or a CCS string, the casing crew arrives ready and stays ready.

tubular-running-services-page.label: Documentation
tubular-running-services-page.title: Documentation
tubular-running-services-page.text: Every job leaves with a job package. Make-up reports, tally confirmation, thread inspection records, equipment logs. The documentation supports operator audits and protects integrity from the connection up.

drilling-services-page.label: Equipment Assessment
drilling-services-page.title: Equipment Assessment
drilling-services-page.text: Pre-job inspection of the equipment that will be verified. Connection specs, torque requirements, and program-specific calibration targets confirmed before the work starts.

drilling-services-page.label: Calibration & Setup
drilling-services-page.title: Calibration & Setup
drilling-services-page.text: Independent calibration of power tongs, top drives, iron roughneck systems, and hook load equipment to manufacturer or program specification. Test fixtures, traceable standards, and documented results.

drilling-services-page.label: Live Verification
drilling-services-page.title: Live Verification
drilling-services-page.text: Real-time monitoring during operations. Every connection, every joint, every measurement captured and documented. Anomalies flagged in real time so the crew can act.

drilling-services-page.label: Reporting & Handoff
drilling-services-page.title: Reporting & Handoff
drilling-services-page.text: Documentation that supports operator audits, equipment performance reviews, and AFE justification. Numbers operators can act on, records they can stand behind.

midstream-services-page.label: Scope & Planning
midstream-services-page.title: Scope & Planning
midstream-services-page.text: Pre-job scoping with the operator or EPC. Trades required, timeline, materials, site access, and any specialty considerations (pipe materials, environmental constraints, permitting) locked in before mobilization.

midstream-services-page.label: Trade Coordination
midstream-services-page.title: Trade Coordination
midstream-services-page.text: Internal trade coordination across electrical, instrumentation, mechanical, civil, and specialty piping. ProTorque’s in-house capability removes the friction of managing multiple subcontractors on a single job.

midstream-services-page.label: Execution
midstream-services-page.title: Execution
midstream-services-page.text: Crews on site. Work executed to spec, on schedule, with the same field discipline ProTorque brings to drilling and casing operations. Coordination with operator field representatives throughout.

midstream-services-page.label: Documentation
midstream-services-page.title: Documentation
midstream-services-page.text: Job package delivered. As-built documentation, weld records, inspection reports, environmental compliance records. The operator has what they need for audits, regulatory reporting, and ongoing facility management.
